title: LibScript Execution Plan Shared Definitions
description: Shared stage, task, and target schema definitions composed across LibScript execution-plan*.schema.json specifications.

semver_string.description: Semantic version identifier for the execution plan or profile specification (e.g., 1.0.0).

profile_identifier.description: Unique lowercase profile or execution plan identifier.

service_list.description: Ordered list of system daemon or service identifiers enabled in the target image.

stage_task.description: Atomic component action executed within an execution plan stage.

component.description: Target LibScript component identifier or category/component path.

action.description: Lifecycle verb invoked on the component (e.g., download, install, configure, start).

version.description: Requested component version string or alias.

env.description: Key-value environment variable overrides scoped to this task execution.
